functions.get_item(sku: str) -> dict|None: returns {"sku","name","price" (float dollars),"category"} or None if sku unknown
functions.get_customer(customer_id: str) -> dict|N: returns {"id","name","discount" (fraction, e.g. 0.10),"region" (e.g. "TX")} or None if id unknown
functions.get_price(sku: str, customer_id: str) ->: discounted unit price in dollars = price * (1 - discount); None if either id unknown

why: Team coding standard: dollars as floats, percentages as fractions, lookups return None when not found. Pricing owns catalog and customer data.

compute_tax.region: str region code from rates.csv (e.g. "TX"), or null for an unknown customer (tax 0). An unrecognised non-null region raises KeyError.
compute_tax.lines: list of (category: str, amount_cents: int) for every line of the order; amounts are integer cents
compute_tax.discount_pct: customer discount in percent numbers (10 = 10%), applied to the taxable sum only; default 0
compute_tax.returns: tax in integer cents, computed on the total taxable sum (not per line), rounded half up to the cent

tax_rate.returns: percent number from rates.csv; None -> 0; unknown non-null region raises KeyError

is_exempt.returns: True if category is listed in exempt_categories.csv; unknown categories are taxable

value.units: money in integer cents, percentages in percent numbers
value.data: tax.py loads data_tax/ relative to its own file path

why: Defines how invoice.py calls tax.py. Money in cents and percents per team standard. Unknown customer (None) -> 0% follows RULES.md; unknown region string -> KeyError follows team standard. Tax computed on order total, not per line, per RULES.md.

pricing.discount_multiplier: customer_id -> Decimal (0.90 = 10% off; 1 = no discount, returned for unknown customer; this is the one default that is not 0)

tax.tax_for: (customer_id, lines, discount) -> (tax_amount Decimal rounded to cent, tax_multiplier Decimal e.g. 1.0825; lines = [(sku, line_amount Decimal)] for known skus only; discount = Decimal dollars; tax.py owns the taxable base; multiplier 1 and tax 0 for unknown customer)

value.invoice: render_invoice computes line amounts, subtotal, discount = round_half_up(subtotal*(1-discount_multiplier)), total = subtotal - discount + tax

why: Interfaces between modules were not fixed; this proposes concrete signatures. Open issue: the spec example shows Tax 1.86 at 8.25%, which implies a taxable base of about 22.50, not 35.19 (subtotal minus discount). tax.py must decide the base from lines+discount.

Pricing section conflicts with the team standard (lookup that finds nothing returns None; money as float dollars; percentages as fractions). Unknown-id defaults of 0 / empty string / multiplier 1 would be silently wrong for invoice code, and Decimal is not our standard. I propose PRICING_API (get_item/get_customer/get_price, return None when not found, float dollars, discount as fraction). Tax part is agent2's to decide and I take no position on it here.
Withdrawn in favour of PRICING_API and tax_api, which are already proposed. invoice.py will adapt to them (convert floats/cents to Decimal dollars internally).
invoice.py uses get_item (existence, price, category) and get_customer (name, discount, region). I convert price to Decimal via str().

invoice.py calls compute_tax(region, lines=[(category, cents)], discount_pct) and tax_rate(region) for the displayed percent. Fits PRICING_API: region from get_customer (None for unknown customer), category from get_item. Tax's cents/percent-number units are agent2's choice; pricing returns float dollars, so invoice converts (price*100, discount*100) at the boundary.
